content.thinking: Journals 2474 and 2475 fall in closed periods 5 and 6, but their POST_DT precedes the close dates and the numbering is out of sequence with invoices 802/803 — however, lacking an entry timestamp, I can't confirm a late posting, so I won't flag this as a closed-period finding.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by 1 having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journals 1368 and 2245 are unbalanced: debits exceed credits by 18.00 and 9.00 respectively (expense debit does not equal AP credit).

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') cr_ap, (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") dr_total from "APINVH" i where i."INV_ID" in (743,222,757) and (i."INV_AMT"<>(select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') or i."INV_AMT"<>(select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO"))
findings.summary: Invoice 743 has INV_AMT 23,078.91 but its journal 2221 records only 23,051.91 (27.00 short on both sides, journal is balanced so it is only detectable by tying invoice to ledger). Invoices 222 and 757 also differ from their journals' debit side (journals 1368/2245 debit 9,890.12 and 6,631.24 vs invoices 9,872.12 and 6,622.24).

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLCOA" c on c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" where c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
findings.summary: Journal 1367 posts a debit of 7,297.51 to account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous, which is retired (ACTV_FLG=N). The memo says the charge is to 5400 Software.

findings.evidence_sql: select a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID", a."VEND_CD", a."INV_AMT", a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO" from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and a."INV_AMT"=b."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoices 802 and 803 are the same vendor (V0008), same amount 3,857.58, both 'Monthly rent', entered with different invoice numbers a month apart and both left open, with journals 2474 and 2475 posted out of sequence. Likely a duplicated supplier document.
